headline.purpose: Page h1 on student, account and near-empty pages.

title.purpose: Admin page h1 and section headings.

body.purpose: Nearly all UI text, tables and form values.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and table column headers, in Faded Ink.

shadows.name: soft-lift
shadows.purpose: Above the page only: primary CTA, dialogs, hero step markers. Dark: 0 18px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35).

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Default hover fill change on buttons and nav rows.

motion.name: cta-press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on the primary CTA only.

motion.name: route-fallback-in
motion.purpose: Suspense fallback fades in only when a load is slow.

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The thing to press. Lamp Amber fill; the primary CTA variant adds soft lift and a press-in.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #a15c00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent { background: var(--color-accent, #a15c00); color: var(--color-on-accent, #fcfbfd); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: The workhorse. Desk Lavender fill; hover becomes the amber tint used for selection.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: var(--color-surface-muted, #f0eef6); color: var(--color-ink, #1d1b33); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background: var(--color-accent-tint, rgba(161, 92, 0, 0.17)); } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #a15c00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destroys or undoes. A solid rose fill so it can never read as an error message.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 12px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: var(--color-alert, #b0304e); color: var(--color-on-accent, #fcfbfd); transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #a15c00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Labelled Field
components.description: Uppercase label wrapping a borderless Desk Lavender control; amber ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font: 600 12px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f5980); } .ds-input { border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--color-surface-muted, #f0eef6); color: var(--color-ink, #1d1b33); outline: none; transition: box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f5980); } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-focus-ring, #a15c00); }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Fully round status marks: tint fill, status-coloured text.
components.html: VERIFIED REJECTED SUBMITTED
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font: 600 11px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-ok { background: var(--color-success-tint, rgba(31, 107, 77, 0.13)); color: var(--color-success, #1f6b4d); } .ds-pill-bad { background: var(--color-alert-tint, rgba(176, 48, 78, 0.13)); color: var(--color-alert, #b0304e); } .ds-pill-wait { background: var(--color-accent-tint, rgba(161, 92, 0, 0.17)); color: var(--color-ink, #1d1b33); }

components.name: Alert Banner
components.description: The one status banner: tint fill plus status text, no border.
components.html: Registration is closed for this cycle.
components.css: .ds-banner { border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--color-alert-tint, rgba(176, 48, 78, 0.13)); color: var(--color-alert, #b0304e); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Desk Lavender rail with a right hairline; the current row carries the amber tint.
components.html: RegistrationsSubjects
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 236px; padding: 12px; background: var(--color-surface-muted, #f0eef6); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-stroke, #dcd8e7); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1b33); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface-1, #fcfbfd); } .ds-nav-current { background: var(--color-accent-tint, rgba(161, 92, 0, 0.17)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #a15c00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Page Heading
components.description: Every admin page opens with a Playfair h1 and a one-sentence subtitle.
components.html:
Registrations

Review and verify backlog registrations for your department.
components.css: .ds-head h1 { margin: 0; font: 600 24px/32px 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1d1b33); } .ds-head p { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f5980); }

narrative.overview:
The portal is an orderly college office rendered on screen. Surfaces are quiet, paper-like and faintly violet; text is indigo ink; one warm colour, Lamp Amber, marks whatever you can act on. Nothing is painted to look important. The college crest supplies identity, so there is no chrome colour, no branded header bar and no decorative panel. Serif headings give the pages the voice of an official document, and the body is a plain, legible sans.

Density follows the surface. Student pages are spacious and single-purpose, and admin pages are table-first working screens. Both share one vocabulary: separation comes from a fill, spacing or a hairline rule, never from an outlined box. Components are calm and exact. Sizes are fixed, only colour varies, and hover is always a different fill rather than an edge appearing. Motion is minimal: colour transitions, a slight press on the primary action, and a delayed fade for slow route loads.

Dark mode is the same desk at night. The Night Registry navy (#201e3c) is the page, raised surfaces get lighter rather than darker, and every colour is desaturated as well as lightened so nothing glows.
keyCharacteristics: Three colours with fixed meanings (act, went through, went wrong); everything else is neutral.
Fills, spacing and hairlines, never outlines.
One button geometry; tone is the only variable.
Playfair Display headings over Inter body.
Light and dark are equal citizens; every colour token has both values.

rules.name: The Three Meanings Rule
rules.body: Amber = act, green = went through, rose = went wrong. A fourth colour is a new meaning, not a styling choice. If it can't be named in one word, it doesn't ship. Warning shares rose's fill instead of introducing amber-as-warning.

rules.name: The Tint-Is-Alpha Rule
rules.body: Every -tint is its base colour at low alpha, never a separate hex, so a tint can never drift from the colour it belongs to.

rules.name: The Up-Is-Lighter Rule
rules.body: In dark mode a raised surface is lighter than the page, never equal and never darker.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks First Rule
rules.body: Every heading is Playfair Display, and nothing else is. A serif in body copy or a sans headline breaks the document voice.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: Below 40rem every text input, select and textarea renders at 16px, or iOS zooms the page on focus and never zooms back out.

rules.name: The Measure-Against-the-Window Rule
rules.body: Mobile layout is verified at 375px wide. Widths are measured against the real window, never the viewport constant, because Linux scrollbars eat ~15px.

rules.name: The Shadow-Means-Above Rule
rules.body: A shadow is never an outline substitute. If it is separating something from the page it sits on, use a fill instead.

dos: Do reach for a token utility (bg-surface-muted, text-ink-muted, bg-accent-tint) for every colour, and add a token to index.css when none fits.
Do separate with a fill, spacing or a single-edge hairline in Hairline Lilac.
Do build every button from the shared btn(tone, size) system and every labelled control from Field.
Do give every colour token both a light and a dark value, and check both themes.
Do keep motion to colour transitions (150–200ms), the CTA press and the 300ms-delayed route fade, all of which collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do open every admin page with a Playfair h1 and a one-sentence subtitle.
donts: Don't draw a four-sided outline (border border-stroke, rounded-xl border) or underline links on hover. npm run lint:no-box fails on it.
Don't add a fourth colour, a Tailwind palette class (bg-red-50) or a raw hex.
Don't use a shadow for anything but "above the page".
Don't give two adjacent buttons different sizes or radii.
Don't use pure white text in dark mode, or let a raised surface equal the page.
Don't add flashy animation or a motion library.
Don't paint the top band or sidebar in a brand colour. The crest is the identity.
